The issue arises when there is not enough space to display the long description within the specified width, causing the infinite loop.

To address this issue, we need to investigate the wrapping logic in the `HelpFormatter` class to understand why it goes into an infinite loop when handling long descriptions.

Next, I will examine the relevant method in the `HelpFormatter` class to pinpoint the root cause of the infinite loop issue.
